caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object with a mechanical structure, shown in grayscale on a plain, light background. The object consists of two primary vertical, intertwined elements that appear to be twisted rods, each ending in a hook at the top. At the midpoint, the rods are joined by a central rivet or pin, forming a pivot point. Extending downward from this joint, each rod curves outward, terminating in semicircular, clasp-like shapes that are open at the end and equipped with small tabs or hooks at the tips. The right rod features an additional upward extension that bends in a loose, irregular “S” curve with a rounded knob at its terminal point. The drawing uses shading to emphasize the metallic texture and contours of the object. The artist's signature “J. Lipkin” is inscribed in small text near the bottom right corner of the image. The entire composition is centered, with no other objects or background elements present.
title: Kettle Tilter
